name: Pinball Alley
design_intent:
S3 SOCCER TRIALS #6 (proposed slot 6, trials_expansion_2026-07-19) -- the CAROM course (escalates s3_wall_pass's single bank to a double bank). The goal is tucked in the bottom-right corner pocket (zone x1980-2300, y800-1100); the direct line is sealed by a tall bumper BAFFLE (x1300-1420, y600-1220). The intended solve is a committed lofted drive OVER the baffle that reads TWO live bumper cushions -- the chamber CEILING (bank 1, redirects down) and the BACK WALL (bank 2, redirects left) -- funneling the ball down into the corner. Restitution 0.85 keeps the caroms lively.

DERIVED BANK (Ball._drive_from dv=(500+0.9*speed)/0.6, restitution 0.85; gravity 1600; boost 760): ball rests at (800,1040). To pass OVER the baffle (top y600) the ball must be lofted to center < 540 at x1300 (ball bottom above the baffle top). A full-boost drive at ~55deg (strike well under the ball, flying up-right) gives 1973 px/s => vx 1132, vy -1616: at the baffle x1300 (dx=500), t=0.442s, center y = 1040 - 1616*0.442 + 800*0.195 = 482 -- ball bottom 542 CLEARS the baffle top (600). It keeps rising into the chamber and meets the bumper CEILING (x1420-2320, y300-400): at x1420, t=0.548s, center y~394, ball top ~334 inside the ceiling band => BANK 1 down. It descends right and strikes the BACK WALL (x2320-2460) => BANK 2 leftward (x0.85), dropping into the corner pocket (goal_zone x1980-2300, y800-1100), where the inner left lip (bumper x1900-1960, y980-1220) traps it. SCORE.

WHY THE DIRECT/WEAK LINES FAIL (carom guard): a flat or shallow drive hits the baffle FACE (x1300, y600-1220) and rebounds LEFT over deck A -- the direct pitch-level line is fully walled. A weak lofted drive that fails to clear the baffle top (600) also rebounds. And a soft over-the-top touch bleeds too much energy to the two 0.85 cushions and stalls, dropping into the void gap (deck A ends x1300; the pocket floor deck B starts x1420) => OOB => reset. So only a POWERFUL, well-read loft supplies the energy for two live caroms into the corner. A super caps the ball at 2400 and tends to overshoot the ceiling/back-wall geometry high, so a committed normal boost loft is the tool; misses settle or fly OOB and auto-reset (2.8s), unlimited tries.

NO-AUTO-SCORE GUARD: the baffle (x1300-1420, standing from y600 to the void line) sits directly between the ball's rest position and the goal chamber; a resting ball (v=0 < BALL_LAUNCH_SPEED 220) has no impulse source and cannot loft itself over a 500px-high lip, so the corner goal can never latch without a player-supplied power drive.

FLIGHT-REQUIRED (player, GAME_ESSENCE): spawn (400,1000), 400px from the ball; the player must FLY into the ball with a committed high-angle boost drive (a passive bounce cannot generate the ~55deg power loft that clears the baffle). Deck marshmallow, baffle/ceiling/back-wall/lip all bumper, void below the approach kills -- a player chasing a flubbed ball into the gap falls => free respawn. NOTE FOR THE RENDERED PASS: the two-cushion carom is the tight-margin element (baffle clearance ~58px at the ideal 55deg full-boost loft; both banks scale with extra approach speed from a short dive run-up) -- validate the ball funnels into the corner and does not escape back left over the lip. Diff-4 read.
hint: NO DIRECT LINE - BANK IT INTO THE CORNER
